title: optimize-quant-kernels-int8-fp8-smoothquant-dequant-fusion-kvcache-batching
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: reduce per-token cost and tail latency for quantized models by improving INT8/FP8 kernels, fusing smoothquant scaling + dequant where possible, and making KV cache and continuous-batching scheduling quant-aware. This PR implements fused dequant+matmul code paths, a new smoothquant pre-scale fusion, and scheduler heuristics to preserve KV cache locality under continuous batching. Changes include kernel micro-optimizations, AVX/WMMA codepaths for FP8, fallbacks to INT8 for older hardware, unit and integration tests, and benchmark harness updates. Checklist: [x] kernel implementations, [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] microbenchmarks, [x] CI green, [x] rollout plan. Related: Linear ENG-1743, ENG-1811. See design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1743/quantization-fusion-and-scheduler-updates. CI: observed a flaky streaming test during first run, re-ran and green. Rollout: gradual canary with traffic shaping (10% -> 50% -> 100%) pinned to dedicated pools; fallback to fp16/quantized reference on regressions.
commits: 3 commits: a1b2c3 Improve INT8 matmul kernel and vectorization; d4e5f6 Add smoothquant scale+dequant fusion and kernel registration; f7g8h9 Update KV cache scheduler to be batch-size and quant-aware, add end-to-end tests
discussion: Carlos Gomez (reviewer): Nice work on the fused path. Two nits: please add a comment on the INT8 fallback thresholds and factor out the duplicated scale math.
Maya Chen (author): Added comment and factored out ScaleUtils::apply_scale. PTAL.

Priya Nair (reviewer): Scheduler change looks good but we should be careful about cross-tenant batching on Dedicated. Can we add a guard to only enable quant-aware batching when tenant isolation is guaranteed?
Maya Chen (author): Added a guard and unit test. By default the scheduler keeps tenant-affine batching off for shared pools; the canary config enables it for dedicated clusters.
Ethan Park (approver): Verified microbenchmarks on P4 and A100; 1.6x throughput on INT8 path and median token latency reduced by ~15% at 2048 seq. Approving to merge.
CI Bot: flaky-test-streaming failed on first run, re-run succeeded. All checks passed.
release_notes: Performance: Optimized quantized kernels (INT8/FP8) and fusion of smoothquant scaling with dequant to reduce dequant overhead. Scheduler: quant-aware continuous-batching heuristics and KV cache locality improvements. Outcome: up to 1.6x throughput on quantized workloads and ~15% median latency reduction at common sequence lengths. Rollout: canary on Dedicated pools with automatic rollback on quality regressions.
